### Checklist

- [x] I searched related issues but found no solution.
- [x] The bug persists in the latest version.
- [x] Issues without environment info and a minimal reproducible demo are hard to resolve and may receive no feedback.
- [x] If this is not a bug report but a general question, please start a discussion at https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/discussions. Otherwise, it will be closed.
- [x] Please use English. Otherwise, it will be closed.

### Describe the bug

`RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4` produces severely incorrect 2D grounding coordinates in SGLang on CUDA. (Drawing/founding incorrect coordinates)

The same checkpoint, image, and prompt are accurate in vLLM.

A/B testing isolated the regression to the CUDA fused QK-RMSNorm + RoPE + output-gate path in:

`python/sglang/srt/models/qwen3_5.py`

Current CUDA dispatch:

```python
if _is_cuda and self.attn_output_gate:
    q, k, v, gate = self.forward_prepare_cuda_fused(...)
````

Forcing the native path fixes the grounding result.

Evidence

The test is finding certain text on page. Same image, target text expected pixel bbox:

`[618, 648, 702, 664]`

| Runtime                            | Predicted pixel bbox   | Center error |    IoU |
| ---------------------------------- | ---------------------- | -----------: | -----: |
| SGLang fused CUDA path             | `[420, 675, 548, 694]` |     178.3 px |      0 |
| vLLM 0.27.1                        | `[618, 645, 699, 662]` |       2.9 px | 0.7146 |
| SGLang with native QK norm + MRoPE | `[618, 645, 699, 661]` |       3.4 px | 0.6635 |

Other A/B tests did not fix the error, including changing image max/min pixels, full-attention, multimodal-attention, GDN prefill/decode, FP4 GEMM, FP8 GEMM, image processing, and deepstack paths.

This strongly implicates `forward_prepare_cuda_fused()` / `fused_qk_gemma_rmsnorm_rope_gate()` for multimodal MRoPE.

### Reproduction

Example server:

```bash
sglang serve \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --model-path /models/RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 \
  --context-length 8192 \
  --max-running-requests 1 \
  --max-total-tokens 8192 \
  --max-mamba-cache-size 1 \
  --disable-radix-cache \
  --disable-cuda-graph \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.75 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 30000
```

Send an image grounding request asking for the normalized `[x_min,y_min,x_max,y_max]` bbox of a known text element.

With the fused CUDA path the returned coordinates are strongly displaced horizontally. The same request is accurate in vLLM.


Workaround/Found solution/crutch

Bypass the fused CUDA preparation path for this multimodal model:

```diff
- if _is_cuda and self.attn_output_gate:
+ if False and _is_cuda and self.attn_output_gate:
```

This causes SGLang to use `forward_prepare_native()`, including the normal:

```python
q, k = self._apply_qk_norm(q, k)
q, k = self.rotary_emb(positions, q, k)
```

Grounding accuracy immediately changes from 178.3 px center error / IoU 0 to 3.4 px / IoU 0.6635.

A proper fix may be to disable `fused_qk_gemma_rmsnorm_rope_gate` for multimodal/MRoPE inputs until that kernel supports MRoPE correctly.

## Environment
* Docker desktop in * Windows 11 pro on WSL2
* GPU: NVIDIA RTX 5090, SM120, 32 GB
* CUDA: 13.0.3
* SGLang: `lmsysorg/sglang:dev` 0.0.0.dev1+gf825d7293 Commit: f825d729363136a2d4a4b330fa694d0b37a878fa
* FlashInfer: 0.6.17
* Model: `RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4`
* Loaded architecture: `Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration`
* Quantization: `modelopt_mixed` / NVFP4 + FP8
* Comparison runtime: vLLM 0.27.1

comments.body:
Independent confirmation on a different Blackwell GPU. I am not attaching the evaluated desktop image because it contains private information.

### Environment

- Windows 11 + Docker Desktop / WSL2
- NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition, 96 GB, driver 596.36
- SGLang image: `lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-cu13-20260821-f825d729`
- SGLang: `0.0.0.dev1+gf825d7293`
- PyTorch: `2.13.0+cu130`; CUDA: 13.0
- Single GPU / TP=1

### Models and launch conditions tested

1. Official `Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8`
   - weights auto-detected as FP8
   - BF16 KV cache
   - context length 32768
   - `--max-running-requests 1`
   - `--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 1`
   - `--disable-prefill-cuda-graph`
   - no MTP/speculative decoding
2. `RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4`, with MTP enabled and disabled
3. Two additional NVFP4 checkpoints, including an RTX-5090-targeted checkpoint

Request settings were deterministic: temperature 0, thinking disabled, JSON-only normalized `[0,1000]` `bbox_2d` output.

### Result

The test uses a fixed 3840x2160 image and three unambiguous UI controls whose true click centers were measured locally.

| Backend / weights | Run | Click-safe hits | Mean center error |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| SGLang, official FP8, no MTP | 1 | 0/3 | 282.9 px |
| SGLang, official FP8, no MTP | 2 | 0/3 | 276.4 px |
| SGLang, RadixArk NVFP4, no MTP | 1 | 0/3 | 574.8 px |
| llama.cpp, GGUF Q4_K_M + F16 vision projector + MTP | repeated manual checks | 3/3 | click-safe |

The two official-FP8 runs were stable but wrong. Their per-target center errors were:

- Run 1: 298.1 px, 170.0 px, 380.7 px
- Run 2: 302.0 px, 168.0 px, 359.2 px

This is not one constant x/y offset: the error direction and magnitude differ by target. FP8 improves the distance compared with NVFP4, but does not make any target click-safe. Disabling MTP also does not fix it. Since the official FP8 checkpoint leaves the vision-related sensitive modules in BF16, the failure does not appear limited to an NVFP4-quantized vision encoder.

As a control, a synthetic 3840x2160 fixture containing three large, isolated colored buttons scores 3/3 on both SGLang 0.5.17 and the same nightly. The failure is specific to fine-grained grounding in a realistic, crowded UI scene.

This independent result appears consistent with:

- #35345: a `(3, T)` multimodal mRoPE position tensor reaching a fused kernel that consumes only one position row
- #35772: SGLang vision features diverging from Transformers/vLLM on fine-grained grounding

It also expands this issue beyond NVFP4: the official FP8 checkpoint reproduces the same failure on a 96 GB Blackwell GPU.

I can test a build that guards `positions.ndim == 1` / forces the native mRoPE path, or any other proposed patch. If maintainers need a shareable fixture, I can build a sanitized desktop-like image, but the private source image will not be uploaded.

title: [Bug] Qwen 3.8 27b NVFP4 incorrect coordinate detection on image
